title_zh: 轨迹织城年度运营与开发者社区登记册
title_en: RailWeave Annual Operations and Developer Community Register
authority_boundary_zh: 以下均为年度运营候选机制，不表示活动、场地、合作主体、经费或日历日期已经确定。任何活动须在场地权利、安全容量、预算、责任角色及必要审批依法落实后方可启动。
authority_boundary_en: All entries are candidate annual operating mechanisms. They do not confirm events, sites, partners, funding, or calendar dates. No activity may start until site rights, safe capacity, budget, accountable roles, and required approvals are lawfully established.

annual_cycle.cycle_position_zh: 年度启动段；具体月份待依法确定
annual_cycle.cycle_position_en: Annual opening period; exact months remain subject to lawful determination
target_groups_zh: 居民与公共服务使用者
outputs_zh: 进入或不进入PoC的书面理由
outputs_en: Written rationale to enter or not enter PoC

conversion_destination.condition_zh: 仅将已通过G1的需求转为受控测试任务
conversion_destination.condition_en: Only demands that pass G1 may become controlled test briefs

kpi_evidence_en: Completeness of reasons for not entering PoC
cancel_or_exit_zh: 必要人工服务无法保留
场地或参与支持条件不足
cancel_or_exit_en: Necessary human service cannot be retained

annual_cycle.cycle_position_zh: 受控验证段；频次依据测试能力确定
annual_cycle.cycle_position_en: Controlled validation period; frequency depends on verified testing capacity
minimum_inputs_zh: 固定版本与测试任务书
outputs_zh: 通过、限用、整改或停止结论
outputs_en: Pass, restricted-use, corrective-action, or stop decision

conversion_destination.condition_zh: 验证结论只作为采购或合作输入，不替代依法决定
conversion_destination.condition_en: Validation is only an input to procurement or cooperation and never replaces a lawful decision

cancel_or_exit_zh: 消防、保险或隔离条件不足
cancel_or_exit_en: Insufficient fire, insurance, or isolation conditions

annual_cycle.cycle_position_zh: 条件性转化段；依据真实需求与合法程序组织
annual_cycle.cycle_position_en: Conditional conversion period organised only around real demand and lawful procedures

conversion_destination.condition_zh: 仅在预算、合同、场地和人工服务条件落实后进入限定部署
conversion_destination.condition_en: Bounded deployment begins only after budget, contract, site, and human-service conditions are established

kpi_evidence_en: Rate of legally actionable pathway opinions
cancel_or_exit_zh: 预算或采购权限不成立
全生命周期成本不可承受
无法保留申诉与普通服务
cancel_or_exit_en: Appeal or ordinary service cannot be retained

annual_cycle.cycle_position_zh: 每项限定部署达到复核节点时触发
annual_cycle.cycle_position_en: Triggered when each bounded deployment reaches its review point

core_space.label_zh: 实际部署现场与公开复盘接口
core_space.label_en: Actual deployment site and public review interface

target_groups_zh: 公众监督与独立验证角色
target_groups_en: Public oversight and independent validation roles
outputs_zh: 续用、限用、整改或退出建议
outputs_en: Continue, restrict, correct, or exit recommendation

conversion_destination.condition_zh: 以实际公共价值与持续运营证据决定续期、整改或退出
conversion_destination.condition_en: Actual public-value and operating evidence determines renewal, correction, or exit

cancel_or_exit_zh: 维护或退出资源不可用

annual_cycle.brand_zh: 轨迹解编与公共知识年鉴
annual_cycle.brand_en: RailWeave Unweaving and Public Knowledge Yearbook
annual_cycle.cycle_position_zh: 年度归档段；只归档已完成责任接续的项目
annual_cycle.cycle_position_en: Annual archive period; only projects with completed responsibility handoff are archived

core_space.label_en: Three cores and bilingual open archive

minimum_inputs_zh: 有理由的续期、整改或退出决定
设备撤离与场地恢复记录
minimum_inputs_en: Reasoned renewal, correction, or exit decision
outputs_zh: 可复用问题和测试模板
下一年度开放问题清单

conversion_destination.condition_zh: 仅将已清权且未含个人或商业敏感信息的知识重新进入下一周期
conversion_destination.condition_en: Only cleared knowledge without personal or commercially sensitive information may re-enter the next cycle

cancel_or_exit_zh: 包含个人或商业敏感信息
史实或测试结论未完成复核
cancel_or_exit_en: Personal or commercially sensitive information present
Historical facts or test findings not reviewed

developer_community_chain.title_zh: 开发者社区从问题到公共知识的接续链
developer_community_chain.title_en: Developer Community Handoff Chain from Problem to Public Knowledge
developer_community_chain.participation_boundary_zh: 开发者参与不构成采购优先权、供应商资格、投资承诺或部署许可。
developer_community_chain.participation_boundary_en: Developer participation creates no procurement preference, supplier qualification, investment commitment, or deployment permission.

stages.action_zh: 共同理解公开问题并形成可拒绝的PoC任务
stages.action_en: Co-understand a public problem and form a rejectable PoC brief

stages.action_zh: 提交固定版本与可复现测试包，接受独立复核
stages.action_en: Submit a fixed version and reproducible test pack for independent review

stages.action_zh: 在多团队可比较和合法程序下提出应用路径
stages.action_en: Propose an application pathway under comparable multi-team and lawful procedures

stages.action_zh: 与使用者和运维人员共同复核真实使用及公共价值
stages.action_en: Review actual use and public value with users and operations staff

stages.action_zh: 清权后沉淀问题、失败、测试与退出模板
stages.action_en: After rights clearance, retain problem, failure, testing, and exit templates
